title.narrative: Investing for Impact Against Tuberculosis

description.narrative: Nigeria - Tuberculosis - National Tuberculosis & Leprosy Control Programme - NTBLCP. This program has the following goals: To accelerate efforts at ending TB epidemic in Nigeria by ensuring access to comprehensive and high quality patients' centered and community owned TB (TB. TB/HIV and DR-TB) services for all Nigerians by 2026. The objectives of this program are: To increase case notification rate of all forms of TB from 131/100,000 population in 2022 to 142/100,000 population in 2026. To sustain TB treatment success rate beyond the NSP 2021-2026 target of 90% during the grant period. To enrol 100% of diagnosed DR-TB patients on appropriate treatment by 2026
